matched_queries: Discover UK guidance connected to employers' tipping policies, consultation with workers, policy reviews and worker feedback. Keep a connection to staff tips separate from tax treatment and from an assessment that wording must change.

passages.quote:
New legislation came into force in April 2019 requiring all employers to:

provide payslips to all workers

show hours on payslips where the pay varies by the amount of time worked

This guidance is to help employers with the new rules on showing the hours on payslips.
